decision_reason: The top-ranked fusion has 55 DNA and 31 RNA split reads, yet the directly observed ONT junction window has no exact collinear annotated donor; translation is withheld.
dna_only: DNA split reads establish a recurrent somatic rearrangement, but breakends alone do not identify the expressed splice path, CDS start, or junction reading frame.
epitope_message: Not predicted because the observed junction has no justified donor CDS/frame.
interpretation: Strong cross-platform support establishes an expressed rearrangement, not an antigen. This is the clearest example of evidence strength and peptide readiness being separate questions.
limitation: A longer assembled transcript with justified CDS/frame is required before junction-spanning peptides can be enumerated.
